description: This file contains a collection of shell functions used to generate and modify JSON configurations for network device provisioning and system settings, such as interfaces, boards, LEDs, switches, wireless, and system info within an embedded Linux environment, likely for OpenWrt or similar firmware.

methods.name: json_select_array
methods.description: Selects a JSON array with the specified key, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: json_select_object
methods.description: Selects a JSON object with the specified key, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: ucidef_set_interface
methods.description: Configures a network interface with optional parameters like device and protocol.
